item.title: Claude Giroux Becoming Surprising Trade Candidate for Senators
item.description: The Ottawa Senators are looking to boost their roster within the next week leading up to next Friday's trade deadline—if they stay in the playoff hunt between now and then. A top-four defenseman is definitely on the radar.However, if things go awry, we’re hearing that veteran Claude Giroux could become a surprising trade piece for the Sens.
